faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about our treatments and the process at Marsa Project.

items.q: What is Marsa Project and what services does it offer?
items.a: Marsa Project is a dental clinic in Toluca specialized in oral rehabilitation, dental implants, veneers, smile design, whitening, orthodontics, endodontics, pediatric dentistry and dental emergency care.

items.q: How long does a teeth whitening session last?
items.a: An in-clinic whitening session lasts 60 to 90 minutes. The number of sessions needed and how long the result lasts depend on each case and the prior assessment; your specialist will define it at the first visit.
Yes. All our procedures are performed by certified specialists, with up-to-date equipment and under clinical hygiene and safety protocols.

items.q: Do you offer payment plans or financing?
items.a: Yes. We offer flexible payment plans and financing options; the conditions are defined based on the treatment and the total of your plan.

items.q: Do you handle dental emergencies? — fractured tooth or acute pain
items.a: Yes. We handle emergencies such as fractured teeth, acute pain, loss of a tooth or damage to a restoration. Contact us on WhatsApp so we can assign you the nearest available appointment.

items.q: How can I book my first consultation?
items.a: You can book on WhatsApp, through the website form or by calling us directly. The first visit is a clinical assessment: we review your case and give you a treatment plan with timing and cost.

items.q: What does digital smile design include?
items.a: It includes a clinical evaluation, a digital simulation of your new smile and a detailed treatment plan before starting any procedure, so you approve the design.

items.q: How long do the results last?
items.a: It depends on each case and on the prior assessment. In general, whitening can last up to 2 years, veneers up to 10 years and dental implants are a long-term solution. In every case, the result depends on the patient's care and periodic check-ups.

Marsa Project is located at Paseo Cristóbal Colón 128-MZ 027, Residencial Colón y Colonia Ciprés, 50120 Toluca de Lerdo, State of Mexico. We are open Monday to Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. and Saturdays from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
